title: Dockerfile Image Compiler
description: Compiles a Dockerfile and build config. Enforces: exactly one CMD/ENTRYPOINT, non-root user, pinned base image, no secrets in build args, ports match spec, .dockerignore present.

error_codes.DF001: dockerfile-spec.json missing or invalid — required: runtime, entrypoint, ports[]
error_codes.DF002: Dockerfile not found in target directory
error_codes.DF003: Dockerfile must have exactly one effective CMD or ENTRYPOINT instruction
error_codes.DF004: Base image not pinned to a version tag or digest — floating 'latest' not allowed
error_codes.DF005: Container runs as root — must add USER instruction for non-root user
error_codes.DF006: Secret value passed as ARG or ENV in Dockerfile — use runtime secret injection
error_codes.DF007: .dockerignore not present — build context leaks unnecessary files
error_codes.DF008: EXPOSE ports do not match ports declared in spec
